responsibility: Implements lowering of complex arithmetic in GIMPLE into scalar real/imaginary operations. It first runs an SSA propagation lattice to detect degenerate complex values (real-only, imag-only, varying), tracks component SSA names and variables, rewrites PHIs and statements into extracted-component form, expands arithmetic, comparisons, conjugation, and division into scalar code, and cleans up EH/SSA state, providing both the normal optimization-time and required O0 fallback passes that ensure complex operations are representable for later stages.
